description: The rules preset of new games: fixed (the default: every gameplay fix) or original (the data-safety and visual fixes only); a saved game keeps the rules it recorded
Leaving an item store that has a list rewrites CACHE.TMP with the wrong header size and garbles the other stores; fixed: compact layout
The 99th item store's offset overwrites store 1; fixed: compact layout, at most 62 stores, a Put that needs more is refused
The save writer skips the record of a status-0 party slot but writes the full count, so the file is short; fixed: every record written
A member leaving the party has only 0x80 bytes written back, so saints, formulas and items are stale on rejoining; fixed: the whole record
A truncated saved game loads as garbage or ends in DOS; fixed: the load is refused with a notice before anything changes
A saved game with impossible header values (month, day, hour, location) reads past the tables; fixed: the load is refused with a notice
Inn roster: an arrow onto a row past the figure list loads a picture that does not exist and the program ends; fixed: nothing drawn
Inn roster: colour keys act on the slot whose entry equals the row number, so they can change another member's colours; fixed: the row's own character
Inn roster: Heraldry and Select Image on a row with no character change a stale character's shield or figure; fixed: nobody's
Inn roster: the figure preview is drawn in the wrong place, over earlier ones and with the wrong colours; fixed: one place, the right figure
The party information opened in a battle flashes with the battle's palette cycles; fixed: the cycles are held while it is open
Character sheet: the values of the skills from Healing on are printed 3 pixels left of the other skill columns; fixed: in line (GitHub issue 4)
A saved game with two party slots naming one record ends the program on the load screen; fixed: the second slot stays empty
Alt-Q on the travel map answered no frees the map's buffers and a later free ends the program; fixed: the buffers are kept
event-advance with add on a new event leaves twice the value; fixed: the value
stat-cap-assign ignores its 0..99 limit; fixed: the limit applies
member-top-skill always reports skill 6; fixed: the best skill's number
The attribute-sum queries record twice a instead of a + b; fixed: a + b
place-hostile's unrest test has its arguments swapped; fixed: unrest here
place-assign 6 and 11 write each other's shop; fixed: the shop place-query reads
place-assign 37 overwrites every occupied slot instead of shifting the list; fixed: the list shifts
give-item-record-form(-2) gives each member the items twice; fixed: once
A temporary boost owned by the whole party is never taken back at expiry; fixed: taken back from everybody
member-flag-set(-1) does not resolve the leader: the saint is not learned and member 4's formula bytes get the bit; fixed: the leader learns it
St. Cecilia's standing goes to the current place even in the open country (null record); fixed: the nearest city
A saint's weapon-skill boost for a prayer for the party finds no weapons and changes nothing; fixed: the leader's weapons
item-keep-percent starts one past the last stack; fixed: at the last stack
item-grade-flags tests item 0's flags; fixed: each stack's
Whole-party skill and stat boosts apply once per present member or stop at a member above the boost; fixed: each present member once
battle-driver adds the party seed to a location seed twice; fixed: once
The fame cost sets fame to cost - fame; fixed: fame - cost
groups-repair drops every enemy group after the first empty one; fixed: only empty groups
Changing a camp activity gives back an empty stack of item 0 for each empty ingredient slot; fixed: only the formula's ingredients
Changing a camp activity looks for the member's brews only from event slot (number of formulas) up; fixed: every slot
The shop stock test reads the city size from an uninitialised slot; fixed: always the city size - 1
cloud-on-line-test loops one past the last cloud, so an old cloud's copy blocks shots; fixed: only the clouds there are
U with nobody selected and the party split copies a stray member-table byte (nothing visible reads it); fixed: nothing copied
Esc with nobody selected writes the Following bit into the pause byte, leaving the battle half-paused; fixed: no bit written
The loot screen's D reads the floor table as words, so an exited member is not skipped and another slot is; fixed: the slot's own byte
Dissolve Lock uses up a pack entry that may be another stack or past the last one; fixed: only an Eater-Water, the weakest
A lone member's Use Stairs reads his stairs record from the level shown, not his own; fixed: his own level's record
The leader's U reads his stairs record from the level shown; fixed: his own level's record
A member gone through an exit makes the end test treat the others on another level as fled and Away; fixed: he counts in neither test
Door, chest and lock actions of a member on another level act on the level shown; fixed: on his own level
Traps, alarms and secret doors of the level shown are sprung by combatants on other levels; fixed: only those on the level shown
The pack of a fallen combatant becomes a pile on the level shown, not his own; fixed: his own level
The stairs-back record number is written after the level switch (wrong level, or never); fixed: a number past his level's count is not taken
Followers arrive on the level shown, which can turn a left-behind member Away; fixed: placed on the party's level
The woken are placed with the walls and sight of the level shown, so they can land in a wall; fixed: on their own level
The leader's U, O, P, D act through the level shown, by remote or on the wrong stairs; fixed: they do nothing off his level
When no place around the arrival spot is free the member keeps his old coordinates (can stand in the void); fixed: placed by the stairs back, then a member
A resumed battle puts every member on the level shown at his old x/y; fixed: each on his own level
Enemy sight, missiles and effects use the level shown, so hits and targets cross levels; fixed: everything on its own level
A combatant on a hidden level is stopped by the shown level's walls; fixed: tested against his own level
The Devil's Bridge Crossing can set a just-emptied slot able with no record (a ghost member in a saved game); fixed: it stays empty
The D key outside order mode uses up a stack of the selected member (or stray memory); fixed: the leader's Eater-Water
Enter (travel individually) with nobody selected gives an order to member -1 and touches stray bytes; fixed: nothing given
A stairs record's wall-group mark is lost when the level is not saved, so the wall opens again; fixed: the write persists
Esc on the load screen goes on with the emptied party and events; fixed: back to the game as it was
The university card records a failed formulas search as a saints search; fixed: the formulas line is shut
The church-at-night card asked about Mass by day names a stale hour; fixed: the hour named when no Mass is held

Draws the screens clean where the 1992 drawing leaves a leftover (a card picture shown late, a pressed button kept, a stray strip, an old battle box); off: as the original draws them; no game value depends on it
The mouse wheel gives the cursor keys up and down where they move a selection; made of keys a player could press

The Interface switch: comfort (the default) turns on the comfort features (the load list one line a game, the newest first, with its real date; on the map a direction tapped twice or with Shift walks on, made of the map's own key commands); classic is the original interface
At a card menu up and down work with the pointer off the lines and 1..9 choose a line; made of player commands
Replacement pictures from a pack folder drawn over the original ones; the game plays the same
How the 320x200 picture is drawn on a larger window (sharp, even, soft, softcrt, hq, crt, crtplus); only the window changes
A slight tube curvature for the CRT picture filters
Replacement music and battle effects from a pack folder; the original sound drivers keep running muted underneath
A translation pack's words on the screens for the keys it has (docs/LOCALISATION.md); the original's text for every other key; the game plays the same
A font pack's fonts for the game's text (docs/LOCALISATION.md: the HD fonts pack draws the English at the window's resolution); the game's fonts without one; the game plays the same
Mods played with, in load order; a modded game plays differently and its saves get a companion file

A Dissolve Lock order whose Eater-Water was moved away while it waited still opens the lock (the stack at the old slot is used up; with FixStaleDissolveSlot nothing is); planned for Fixed: the order is cancelled and the lock stays shut
The business district's line to the physician is never offered (the house is reached only from the crafts quarter); restored: offered, hidden where the crafts quarter hides its physician
Weapons training with the city guard (council hall line 5) is never offered; restored: offered once a day while the city is not hostile, the written training offers and price follow
The "come back" appointment of the council hall and the fortress never runs its handler, so its one-day welcome (99 per cent admission) is never given; fixed: the appointment runs it
A commission of the City Lord given at the fortress (a city without a town hall) is never paid; fixed: the fortress pays a finished one as the town hall does
The village Schulz's robber-knight task is never paid (the reward card has his case, no card sends there); fixed: the Schulz pays a finished task
An alchemist offers formulas 0..21 only (the offer taken modulo 22, the potions, used as a formula number); fixed: modulo 66, the whole range
The events a battle makes are lost when the table is read back after it (a saint's boost or a price is never undone); fixed: they are kept
The teacher list's rows are numbered by every teacher met in any town (teachers left out, a row picking another town's); fixed: this town's only
A temporary attribute boost cut by the cap is recorded in full, so its end lowers the attribute; fixed: the amount really added is recorded
Claiming friendship with a Hussite band succeeds only when the roll equals the chance; fixed: at or below it, as the other cards
The peat bog's rope line tests the Rope's item type as a flag mask (a polearm, bow or metal armour enable it, a rope does not); fixed: the Rope's flag
A stay left by a click on an empty party row skips its clean-up (Save and Load stay off, brews kept, the music not restored); fixed: the clean-up runs

The road table's rolls 19 to 22 of 29 always meet card 0x104 (483.07 removed the branch of 483.04-.06); restored: near St. Joachimsthal, Buerglitz, Prag, Kuttenberg or Bruenn the Hussite band (card 0x119) instead, which marks the city as risen and preparing for war

A bribe or an attack in the city prison frees the companion at once, even before a fight that is then lost; restored: a bribe that works and a won fight lead to the freed companion's card 288 (as 483.04-.06), the attack shows the guards-of-every-floor text first, and a lost fight or flight frees nobody
The clothmakers' street by day never offers its shop line (the guild's non-metal armour is sold only to a party that wakes somebody at night); restored: the day line is offered
Deadly Blade, Strongedge and Great Power never wear off, add up and count with any weapon; fixed: about a day, a new dose replaces the old, each with the weapons the manual names
Hardarmor and Firewall never wear off and Firewall's charm counts as armour against every blow; fixed: about a day, a new dose replaces the old, Firewall guards against flame only
St. Polycarp's charm never wears off; fixed: fire protection 90 for the party for about a day
St. Patrick adds 2 armour against every blow for good; fixed: +2 against missiles for about a day, as his text says
St. Charity gives no fire resistance but a lasting armour charm; fixed: fire protection 90 for the one prayed for and 50 for the others, about a day
St. Erasmus gives no fire resistance but a lasting armour charm; fixed: fire protection 50 for the party for about a day
St. Pantaleon gives no fire resistance but a lasting armour charm; fixed: fire protection 30 and +1 armour against wolves, boars, bears and spiders for the party, about a day
St. Dunstan adds 1 armour against every blow for good; fixed: +20 quality to the party's worn metal armour for about a day, as his text says
The standings with the Fugger, the Medici and the Hanse are not in the saved game (a load keeps the last game's); fixed: kept in the header's spare words behind a marker
Healing (Essence of Grace, a saint) pulls an attribute boosted above its maximum down; fixed: healing restores only what is lost, never past the maximum
Great Power adds to the damage-and-penetration byte (often a worse weapon); fixed: +14/22/30 quality on impact weapons, flails and handguns for about a day, as the manual says
The potion thrown at street footpads stays in the pack; fixed: it is used up, as the card's text says

St. Dismas helps the one member only and gives no Charisma or Speak Common; fixed: as his text says, Agility, Woodwise and Stealth for the whole party, Charisma and Speak Common for the one prayed for
St. Christopher neither speeds travel nor heals; fixed: a little Strength and Endurance healed, and half again as fast overland for a week, as his texts say
St. Michael does not improve the party's weapons and armour; fixed: +20 quality to them in combat for about a day, as his text says
St. Anthony boosts Strength and Endurance above their maximum and takes it back a day later; fixed: healing only"
St. Thomas Aquinas gives no Religion and no standing at monasteries and universities; fixed: Religion +20..39 for a day and the standing where there is a monastery or a university, as his text says
At the city walls by night the grapple's chance is always 0 and everyone climbing always succeeds; fixed: the best climber's and the weakest member's own chances, as by day
